_note: Three fully solved example reactions — NOT from the eval set. Shows the new submission format with steps and electron_pushes.

correct_submission.methodology: SN2 concerted: hydroxide lone pair attacks methyl carbon (backside). C-I bond breaks, iodide leaves. Single concerted step — no discrete intermediate.

scoring_notes.final_products: Correct. CO.[I-] matches ground truth (dot-joined or separate accepted).
scoring_notes.pathway_coverage: Full credit: 1 step submitted, 1 step expected. No intermediates — correct for concerted SN2.
scoring_notes.electron_push_quality: Full credit: push types [lp, sigma] match ground truth exactly.
scoring_notes.explanation: lp:O>C = hydroxide lone pair attacks carbon; sigma:C-I>I = C-I bond electrons flow to iodide.

correct_submission.methodology: N-oxidation: aromatic nitrogen lone pair attacks electrophilic oxygen of peracetic acid. O-O bond breaks heterolytically. Products: pyridine N-oxide + acetic acid. Concerted, 1 step.

scoring_notes.electron_push_quality: Full credit: push type [lp] matches ground truth.
scoring_notes.explanation: lp:N>O = N lone pair flows to electrophilic O of peracid. The O-O bond breaks as electrons move from N to O.

correct_submission.methodology: 2-step epoxide ring opening: (1) Amine lone pair attacks less hindered epoxide carbon (SN2-like), ring opens to give ammonium alkoxide zwitterion. (2) Proton transfer from N to O gives neutral amino alcohol. Two discrete steps with isolable zwitterionic intermediate.

scoring_notes.pathway_coverage: Full credit: 2 steps submitted, 2 steps expected. Intermediate CC[NH2+]CC[O-] is the zwitterion.
scoring_notes.electron_push_quality: Full credit: Step 1 types [lp, sigma] match; Step 2 types [lp, sigma] match.
scoring_notes.partial_credit_example: If you submitted the correct intermediate but wrote 'lp:O>C' instead of 'lp:N>C' (wrong atom type), you would get partial push credit. Push scoring uses type distribution, so lp+sigma in step 1 would still score if you had 1 lp and 1 sigma.
